native_adaptation.branding: Hunk config directories and command names become Workdeck names during migration.
native_adaptation.paths: Rust PathBuf values retain the exact configured strings until discovery resolves them.
native_adaptation.hard_off: The CLI --no-extensions flag is applied after layered config resolution and cannot be re-enabled by either layer.
native_adaptation.bundled_tier: The switch controls user-native extensions only; bundled Git, Jujutsu, and Sapling support remains available.
